ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows triangle JLP, with J at the lower left, P at the lower right, and L above; point M is located on side LP, and segment JM connects from vertex J to point M on side LP; point K is located on side JL, and there is another segment KP. raw_record.question_text: In $\triangle JLP$, $m\angle JMP=3x-6$, $JK=3y-2$, and $LK=5y-8$. If $\overline{JM}$ is an altitude of $\triangle JLP$, find $x$.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: triangle JLP is shown with M located on side LP, and segment JM drawn from vertex J to point M. From the text, JM is an altitude of triangle JLP, so JM is perpendicular to the side LP at M. Since MP lies along LP in the image, angle JMP is the angle between JM and LP, so it must be 90 degrees. Use the given expression m∠JMP = 3x - 6, set 3x - 6 = 90, and solve x = 32. The given JK and LK expressions are not needed for x.
